fixed_income.why: Both sides sit on the fraction-of-par scale: the 180 fixed-income securities in the table have a median close of 1.03 (5th to 95th percentile 0.985 to 1.12; 179 of 180 securities have a median close between 0.8 and 1.2; none is near 100) and the 186 trade dates of those securities carry |Amount|/|Quantity| with median 1.07 (5th to 95th 0.998 to 1.183), with Quantity a par amount (median 35,000), so no times-100 factor applies. NOT CLASSED: every one of the 180 securities' closes begins on 2026-06-08 or later (gold snapshot store only, 14,131 rows) while every one of the 186 trade dates is on or before 2026-05-05, the nearest trade to a close is 34 days, so no same-date pair and no pair within 3 trading days exists. A diagnostic only: 10 securities have a close within 90 days of a trade and the ratio close/trade there is 0.983 to 1.015 (median 0.9997), 5 within 60 days (0.997 to 1.004); accrued interest (a small positive bias in the trade price) is not visible at that resolution.

headline: 8 close series are mis-scaled (6 constant-scale and 2 step: the seven of round 69, all still classed, plus OIEJX, which rests on 3 pairs over 17 days, 2 of them reinvestment prints) -- and that count is a floor: 334 compared securities are still too few to class (209 have a single pair), 44 of the thin ones still carry a pair more than 10 percent off, and 1,700 traded securities have no close in the table at all (1,693 of them held, 974,014 account-days resting on them, every one NOT_MEASURABLE).
not_established: Why any ratio is what it is. Nine new NOISY fund series (AMCPX, AMRMX, CWGIX, WGIFX, CPXIX, FINFX, NEWFX, AWSHX, WMFFX) show a close below the reinvestment price by 16 to 53 percent in 2020-2022 that rises in jumps at each distribution date to about 1.00 by 2025-2026, the shape of a dividend-adjusted close; this was read by eye, not tested, and these series are classed NOISY, not counted in mis_scaled. The scan does not measure how many of the 329 AGREES securities carry the same ramp on dates it cannot see.
OIEJX (the one new CONSTANT_SCALE) spans 17 days (2021-11-29 to 2021-12-16): 3 pairs cannot tell a constant scale from the start of a ramp like the nine above.

The 44 thin securities still carrying a pair beyond 10 percent, and the 334 still too few (209 with one pair), cannot be classed from the custodian rows: the table holds a security only from its first held day in the served window, so a trade before that day has no close within 3 trading days (54,226 print dates in all have no close that day; 54 of them were paired by the 3-trading-day rule; 75 fall on a non-trading day).

The 1,700 with no close: 1,610 have no price row in any of the six local store caches under their CUSIP or under the ticker the transactions give them; that is an absence in the stores as cached locally, not a statement about the live stores or about spellings the transactions do not carry (91 of the 1,700 have no ticker in the transactions at all). 90 have a row only under a ticker that more than one CUSIP claims: a same-date agreement (within 5 percent) of the ticker row with the traded price is shown for 6 of the 25 that overlap a traded date in the silver store and 1 of 2 in the bbg testpull store, and not shown for the rest.
Fixed income: no pair exists, so no class; the unit is read from two distributions and 10 far pairs, not from same-date pairs.

Ticker changes: the transactions carry exactly one Symbol per CUSIP (0 of 4,634 CUSIPs list two), so a CUSIP whose ticker changed cannot be seen from them; the count touched is 0 by construction, not by absence.
Reach counts priced holding-days and measured account-days on the wrong side; it does not value any return. A STEP's gap days are counted separately and not as wrong (T 588, MMM 1,384).

The reinvestment-print precision guard (summed Quantity at least 0.05, because Quantity is rounded to 3 decimals) is this scan's own addition: it removes 210 of 14,908 dvr prints and 14 of 441 leu prints; without it WAB, a share priced 60.00 to 120.00 in dvr rows from 0.001-0.002-share lots, is a false NOISY security.
